regions.name: Mossbell Village
regions.subtitle: Where every path begins
regions.description: Warm roofs, wildflower gardens, and the first page of your story. Visit the blue-roof lodge to heal.

regions.name: Verdant Wilds
regions.subtitle: Follow the rustling leaves
regions.description: Sunlight spills through old-growth canopies. Small Nuvo hide in the deep green grass.

regions.name: Tideglass Coast
regions.subtitle: Treasures between the tides
regions.description: Sea-glass pools shimmer beneath coral cliffs. Follow the coast to Sunwake Harbor.

regions.name: Sunwake Harbor
regions.subtitle: The sea always brings a story
regions.description: Keepers gather beside the lighthouse. Rest, stock up, and head north to the ember fields.

regions.name: Hollow Grove
regions.subtitle: A little strange. A little magical.
regions.description: Giant mushrooms light the woodland. Listen carefully: even the shadows have a song.

regions.name: Crystal Steps
regions.subtitle: Walk through a memory of light
regions.description: A staircase of ancient crystals hums beneath your feet. Rare Nuvo gather in its glow.

regions.name: Emberfall
regions.subtitle: Wild hearts, warm earth
regions.description: Black stone and golden grass surround the sleeping volcano. Watch for tiny sparks in the brush.

regions.name: Frostmere
regions.subtitle: A village under the aurora
regions.description: Snow settles on blue rooftops. The warm healing lodge is a welcome stop before Starfall.

regions.name: Starfall Reach
regions.subtitle: Closer to the impossible
regions.description: Floating motes of light rise from ancient ruins. Some say the first Nuvo awoke here.

regions.name: Saffron Expanse
regions.subtitle: Where the dunes remember
regions.description: Amber dunes circle a colossal half-buried sun dial. The east road leads to a caravan haven.

regions.name: Threadhaven
regions.subtitle: Wear the story you want to tell
regions.description: Tailors and barbers gather beneath windmill sails. Its Champions Hall welcomes courageous crews.

regions.name: Mirelight Fen
regions.subtitle: A thousand lanterns beneath the reeds
regions.description: Luminous lilies and ancient lanterns float over violet water. The causeway winds west toward the storm-carved cliffs.

regions.name: Tempest Shelf
regions.subtitle: Run where the thunder lands
regions.description: Wind-carved cliffs catch violet lightning. The Thunder Harp turns every storm into a song.

regions.name: Crownspire
regions.subtitle: The summit of possibility
regions.description: A marble town above the clouds, home to the final Champions League guardian. Its bells ring for every victorious keeper.

regions.name: Dream Land
regions.subtitle: Somewhere between a wish and waking
regions.description: Floating islands drift through a lavender sky. Seek Oneirune and Dreamweaver beyond the path; touch the Dreaming Gate to return to the Healing Lodge.

regions.name: Brookbend Crossing
regions.subtitle: A river worth following
regions.description: A winding river divides flower meadows and wooded banks. Cross the timber bridges, follow the river bend, then take the north trail into Bramble Labyrinth.

regions.name: Bramble Labyrinth
regions.subtitle: Take the path less certain
regions.description: Living hedges shelter a winding maze, quiet clearings, and a hidden rose court. Follow the trail markers through the switchbacks to Hollow Grove.

regions.name: Echohollow Caverns
regions.subtitle: Listen beneath the mountain
regions.description: Crystal-lit chambers open beneath Crystal Steps. Stone bridges cross underground pools, while unlit gravel shelters cave Nuvo. The south passage descends into Glassvein Tunnel.

regions.name: Glassvein Tunnel
regions.subtitle: From mountain heart to open sea
regions.description: An old mining passage connects Echohollow to Tideglass Coast. Follow lanterns along the main tunnel, or explore branching crystal galleries and the flooded lower shaft.

regions.name: Lantern Lake
regions.subtitle: Little islands, long summer evenings
regions.description: Reed-covered islands dot a deep turquoise lake. A chain of boardwalks and bridges links secluded Nuvo habitats. Threadhaven lies west; the north trail climbs Rimewind Pass.

regions.name: Rimewind Pass
regions.subtitle: Beyond the last snow line
regions.description: A glacial river cuts through switchback terraces and frozen pools. Cross the high bridges and stone stairways to reach Crownspire, or descend south toward Lantern Lake.
